row.evidence_locator: §4 H2O method; §5.2/Table5; Appendix C.6/Table9
row.supported_claim_en: H2O identifies heavy hitters from accumulated attention and dynamically retains both important historical tokens and recent tokens. It evicts KV entries rather than quantizing their values. §5.2/Table5: OPT-6.7B, one A100 80GB, 2,048 prompt plus 2,048 output tokens, batch 24. H2O at 20% budget changes FlexGen latency from 99.5 to 53.5 seconds and throughput from 494.1 to 918.9 tokens/s; timing includes prefill.
row.supported_claim_zh: H2O以累计注意力识别heavy hitters，并动态保留重要历史token与近期token；删除的是KV条目，不是减小每个值的位宽。 §5.2/Table5：OPT-6.7B、单A100 80GB、输入2048+输出2048、batch24，20%预算H2O较FlexGen延迟99.5→53.5秒，吞吐494.1→918.9 token/s；计时含prefill。
